svg.title: V-19. HSI signals · owners, protection and tests (SysML v2 view hsiSignals)
svg.desc: HSI signals view generated from the SysML v2 model. One row per signal S-01 to S-29 of WP-S-05 §11, grouped by its table: vehicle CAN signals (HSI-04), SoC to safety MCU signals (HSI-01 to 03) and safety MCU hardware signals (HSI-05 to 14). Each row gives the direction, the owner elements, whether the signal carries integrity protection and a liveness indication of its own, the ASIL, the TSRs it serves and the number of test cases.
svg.text: V-19 · HSI signals · owners, protection and tests
The 29 safety-relevant signals of WP-S-05 §11 by interface, with the elements that own them, the protection the signal carries, its TSRs and its test cases
Health packet 0xd2 (health_t: controls allowed, faults, safety…
Relay drive (tres PA8 / cuatro PA9; PA3)
SBU1 / SBU2 sense (PC4 / ADC1 ch4, PA1 / ADC1 ch17)
Siren output (DAC/DMA and codec over I2C5, or SAI4 amplif…

29 signals: 11 carry no checksum, CRC or XOR of their own and 22 no counter, alive check or supervision; the receiver's own checks (rates, timeouts, cross-checks) are in the Failure reaction column of WP-S-05 §11.
